draft_text: Tessaline appears to slightly outperform Varrow-NMT in BLEU on the Halvard-Parl English→Estonian test set (28.4 vs 27.6 over 8 seeds).
revised_text: Tessaline appears to slightly outperform Varrow-NMT in BLEU on the Halvard-Parl English→Estonian test set (28.4 vs 27.6 over 8 seeds).
rationale: T1.r1.bleu=28.4 and T1.r2.bleu=27.6 support the mean difference. However, no statistical test (S1) is reported for Tessaline vs Varrow-NMT (cmp1), so "appears to slightly outperform" is appropriately hedged and not claiming significance. The claim is accurate and scoped to the evaluated test set.
